preconditions.description: The length of string S must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of string P must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in string S must be lowercase alphabets.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in P)
preconditions.description: All characters in string P must be lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout) > 0 and all(c in stdout for c in P))
postconditions.description: The output must be '-1' if no valid window exists, otherwise it must contain all characters of P.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == min(len(w) for w in windows if all(c in w for c in P))
postconditions.description: The output must be the smallest window containing all characters of P.

postconditions.expression: any(stdout == w for w in windows if len(w) == len(stdout) and all(c in w for c in P))
postconditions.description: The output must be one of the smallest windows with the least starting index.
